prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1107; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 reported that while changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, the vehicle was sideswiped by a sedan operated by Driver 2. Upon arrival, I observed both vehicles at rest on the shoulder and in the adjacent lane. Driver 1 was present at the scene and was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, a fact confirmed by my observations and by statements from the other parties present. Driver 1 stated experiencing pain to the left shoulder following the impact and was evaluated on scene. The nature of the reported injury is consistent with the force and direction of the contact described. Damage to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with a lateral sideswipe, and I found no indication of prior damage to that area. Scene photographs taken by responding personnel show several details of the collision, though no independent witnesses were identified who observed the impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable policy. Driver 2 was cooperative and provided insurance information. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
